run_GTestOutputTest_testOutput: run the GTestOutputTest test case to compare Google Test output against the golden file
run_GetOutputOfAllCommands: run GetOutputOfAllCommands to collect concatenated output from multiple Google Test representative commands
normalize_NormalizeOutput: normalize Google Test program output by converting line endings, removing locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_RemoveMatchingTests: remove output of specified tests from Google Test output using a regex pattern to match test names
remove_RemoveLocations: remove all file location info from Google Test output and replace with normalized FILE_NAME colon hash colon format
